doc: One gate to build (design/planner.md, Gates): its type, the wall's kind it stands in (so its height, thickness, stone, and crown match), the opening's width along the line, and the season.

fields.name: condition
fields.doc: Intact, or a ruin: broken down, roofless, overgrown, without its moving parts or lit fires.

fields.name: width
fields.doc: The opening along the line, metres: the passage is at least this wide; its piers or towers stand beyond it, over the wall's ends.
